card.name: Epithets after historical names
card.fires_on: The word 'the' or the epithet itself (Great, Younger, Magnificent, Pious) right after a historical or religious person's name, as in Peter the Great or Albert the Great.

modes.label: The after a name
modes.description: The word 'the' placed between a person's name and an epithet that follows.
modes.example: when Peter<< the>> Great returned from his travels in Europe.

modes.label: The epithet itself
modes.description: The nickname word or its ending, such as Great, Younger, Magnificent or Pious, closing a ruler's or saint's name.
modes.example: Under the Frankish king Pippin the Young<<er>> (Pippin III), Aachen

card.plain: It marks the spot in a famous person's name where a title like 'the Great' comes in.
